text: You're in luck because this Mini Quiche recipe is quick, easy, and packed with flavor. It's ready in just 22 minutes, which fits perfectly within your 30-minute time budget. The combination of crispy bacon, caramelized onion, and gooey cheese will surely satisfy your taste buds. Plus, the recipe uses a convenient ready-rolled shortcrust pastry, making it a breeze to prepare. With its balanced nutrition profile and short cooking time, this Mini Quiche is an excellent choice for a speedy and satisfying meal.
